description: This Java source file defines the AdminClient class, which provides methods to communicate with a running OFBiz server instance via socket commands for status checks and shutdown requests.

classes.name: AdminClient
classes.description: Provides static methods to send socket commands to an OFBiz server for status and shutdown operations.

methods.name: requestStatus
methods.description: Sends a socket command to request the current status of the OFBiz server.

methods.name: requestShutdown
methods.description: Sends a socket command to request the OFBiz server to shut down.

methods.name: sendSocketCommand
methods.description: Handles the socket communication, sending a command and reading the response.
